board: 4-channel 5V relay module with optocoupler, low level trigger (common blue Songle board, 4x SRD-05VDC-SL-C; input header GND, IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4, VCC plus JD-VCC/VCC/GND jumper header)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, DRC, footprint, LCSC C35449). IN1-IN4 modelled as actuator inputs with inputsActiveLow; the test confirms relays 1+3 and 2+4 alternate when their inputs are driven low. Marked cabled because the signal header and the screw terminals are on opposite edges.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://components101.com/switches/5v-four-channel-relay-module-pinout-features-applications-working-datasheet (GND, IN1-IN4, VCC, then VCC/JD-VCC jumper); https://shillehtek.com/blogs/shillehtek-product-manuals/4-channel-5v-relay-module-manual (header GND, IN1, IN2, IN3, IN4, VCC, active low)
